brand.tagline: Accounting and financial management for Suriname
brand.metaDescription: Cloud accounting for Surinamese businesses and accounting firms: SRD, USD and EUR, CBvS rates, BTW and annual accounts.

status.intro: ARA Accounting is being built for the Surinamese market: double-entry bookkeeping, receivables and payables, bank and cash, fixed assets, budgets, reporting, year-end closing, BTW returns and annual accounts — in one integrated platform.
status.notYetAvailable: The application is not yet available for use. This page shows the progress.

phases.p2: Accounting core: ledger, journals, journal entries, trial balance
phases.p3: Purchases, sales, bank and cash, current accounts, fixed assets
phases.p5: Foreign currency: CBvS rates, exchange differences, revaluation
phases.p7: ARA Scan: document scanning and booking suggestions
phases.p9: Year-end closing, annual accounts and tax returns
phases.p11: Subscriptions and practice management for accounting firms

highlights.currency: SRD, USD and EUR with Centrale Bank van Suriname rates
highlights.tax: BTW (10% / 25% / 0%) and income tax as configurable, verifiable rules
highlights.law: Annual accounts under the Wet op de Jaarrekening (S.B. 2017 no. 84)
highlights.banks: Import profiles for Surinamese banks and cash books per currency

status.verification: Tax and legal settings are only marked as verified after review by a Surinamese tax advisor and accountant.

assets.title: Fixed assets
assets.startHint: First day of a month; defaults to the month after acquisition.
assets.counterAccountHint: Default 0090 capital expenditure clearing (book the purchase invoice on 0090). Choose 'Already booked' if the acquisition is already on the asset account.
assets.alreadyBooked: Already booked on the asset account (no entry)
assets.addIntro: Registration books the acquisition (debit the category's asset account) and creates the depreciation schedule.
assets.depreciationIntro: Create a proposal per month. The proposal is a draft entry in the depreciation journal and is only posted after approval. A month can never be depreciated twice.
assets.proposed: Depreciation proposal created; approve it from the entry.
assets.nothingToDepreciate: There is nothing to depreciate for this month.
assets.disposeIntro: Depreciation up to the month before disposal must be posted. Book value and proceeds determine the gain or loss.
assets.residualTooHigh: The residual value must be lower than the cost.
assets.startFirstOfMonth: Depreciation starts on the first day of a month.
assets.invalidCounterAccount: This counter account cannot be used here.
assets.counterAccountRequired: Choose the account receiving the proceeds.
assets.alreadyDisposed: This asset has already been disposed.
assets.disposalBeforeAcquisition: The disposal date is before the acquisition date.
assets.pendingDepreciation: A depreciation proposal is still open; post or withdraw it.
assets.depreciationBehind: {months} month(s) of depreciation still to be posted before disposal.

currentAccounts.title: Current accounts
currentAccounts.intro: Current account relationships with directors, shareholders and related parties. Each has its own ledger account.
currentAccounts.signHint: Positive balance: the counterparty owes the company. Negative: the company owes the counterparty.
currentAccounts.interestHint: Records the agreement only; interest is not booked automatically.

directions.INCREASE: Withdrawal / paid on their behalf (receivable increases)

currentAccounts.confirmIntro: Record the balance confirmed by the counterparty; the difference with the books is kept.
currentAccounts.confirmedHint: Same sign convention as the balance (negative allowed).
currentAccounts.invalidCounterAccount: This counter account cannot be used here.

industry.title: Industry templates
industry.intro: An industry template extends the standard Surinamese chart with accounts, journals, asset categories, dimensions and KPIs for a sector. Applying it copies the content into a new administration; later versions are only added after your choice.
industry.platformIntro: Proposals for the Surinamese market, still to be reviewed by a SUVA-registered accountant.
industry.createIntro: Starts as a draft with the content of the chosen template.
industry.importIntro: JSON file made with 'Export' (format ara-industry-template v1).
industry.jsonIntro: For journals, asset categories, dimensions and KPIs. The content is checked on save.
industry.publishIntro: A published version can no longer change and is available for new administrations and upgrades.
industry.savedWithIssues: Saved, but there are issues that block publishing.
industry.publishedImmutable: A published version cannot be changed. Create a new version.
industry.invalidJson: This is not a valid ARA template file.
industry.fileTooLarge: The file is too large (max 512 kB).
industry.issueDuplicateNumber: Account number {number} already exists in the standard chart or the template.
industry.issueReservedNumber: Account number {number} is reserved for cash, bank or current accounts.
industry.issueParent: Account {number}: parent {parent} does not exist or is not a header.
industry.issueAssetCategory: Asset category {code} must use two different fixed-asset accounts.
industry.wizardHint: Extends the standard chart for your sector. More can be added later through an upgrade.
industry.upgradeIntro: Choose what to add. Existing accounts and settings are never overwritten.
industry.upgradeChanged: Account {number}: changed in the template from '{from}' to '{to}'.
industry.upgradeRemoved: Account {number} {name} is no longer in the template; your account remains.
industry.upgradeOutdated: The proposal is outdated; reload the page.

currency.referencePlaceholder: e.g. CBvS publication, bank statement, cambio receipt
currency.importIntro: The CBvS publishes buying and selling rates; there is no confirmed automated feed. Copy the rates into this CSV layout (one row per date and currency). They are stored as 'entered'.
currency.csvErrors: The file has errors on line {lines}.
currency.sameCurrency: Currency and base currency are the same.
currency.rateExists: A rate for this currency, type and date already exists.
currency.rateDecided: This rate has already been decided.
currency.noPolicyRate: No {type} rate for {currency} on or shortly before {date}. Enter the rate or type it on the invoice.
currency.overrideNotAllowed: The policy rate is {rate}. Deviating requires the right to change rates.
currency.policyIntro: Which rate applies to which transaction (agree with your accountant). Bank and cambio transactions always use the actual rate on the statement or receipt.

policy.monetaryAccountsHint: E.g. 0710 for a USD loan. Bank, cash, receivables, payables and current accounts are always included.

modes.AUTO_REVERSE: Reverse on day 1 of the next period

currency.revaluationIntro: Revalues foreign-currency bank, cash, receivables, payables and current accounts at the rate on the last day of the period. Fixed assets, prepayments and equity are not revalued. The proposal is posted after approval by a colleague.
currency.revaluationProposed: Revaluation proposal created; have the entry approved, then post it here.
currency.revaluationExists: A proposal or posted revaluation already exists for this period.
currency.previousNotReversed: An earlier revaluation has not been reversed yet.
currency.revaluationPeriod: Only periods 1 to 12 can be revalued.
currency.nextPeriodMissing: The next period does not exist yet; create the next fiscal year first.
currency.alreadyAutoReversed: This revaluation has already been reversed; correct it with a memorial entry.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.intro: Budgets per fiscal year and scenario, with versions and approval, budget versus actual and a rolling forecast.

statusHelp.SUBMITTED: Submitted: awaiting approval by a colleague.
statusHelp.APPROVED: Approved: this version is fixed. Changes go into a new version.
statusHelp.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a newer approved version.

budgets.createIntro: Choose a basis: empty, last year's actuals or last year's approved budget, optionally adjusted by a percentage.
budgets.thresholdHint: Unfavourable variances from this percentage are flagged.
budgets.gridIntro: Revenue and costs as positive amounts. Empty is zero.
budgets.gridReadOnly: This version can no longer be changed.
budgets.distributeIntro: Spreads a yearly amount over 12 months without losing a cent.
budgets.importIntro: Account number with 12 monthly amounts, or one row per account and period. Existing amounts for the same months are replaced.
budgets.csvErrors: The file has errors on line {lines}.
budgets.invalidAccount: Only profit and loss accounts can be budgeted.
budgets.notDraft: Only a draft version can be changed.
budgets.openVersionExists: A draft or submitted version already exists.
budgets.noPriorYear: There is no previous fiscal year.
budgets.noPriorBudget: There is no approved budget for last year in this scenario.
budgets.alertsTitle: {count} account(s) deviate unfavourably by {pct}% or more:
budgets.reportNote: Actual = posted entries only in periods 1–12. Variance = actual − budget. Click an account for the general ledger card.
budgets.forecastIntro: Actuals up to the chosen month, then the budget.
